scope_note: Covers whether any secondary legislation was made under the enabling power in section 117 of the Education (Scotland) Act 1962. Limited to legislation. Does not cover section 117 of the later Education (Scotland) Act 1980, which is a different statute.

steps.title: Retrieve the Education (Scotland) Act 1962
steps.detail: The Act is held under its regnal-year identifier `ukpga/Eliz2/10-11/47` and is reachable by section search, not by title search or by the modern-form identifier `ukpga/1962/47`. Retrieve it and record which route works.

steps.title: Read section 117 as it now stands
steps.detail: Read section 117 in the retrieved Act and record whether any text of it survives, so that nothing is asserted about the terms of the power itself.

steps.title: Read the enabling preamble of each candidate instrument
steps.detail: For every Scottish education instrument that a search surfaces as a plausible candidate, retrieve its full text and read the preamble, which names the sections it was made under. That preamble, not the instrument's subject matter, is the evidence of the enabling power.

steps.title: List only instruments whose preamble names section 117
steps.detail: Report the instruments whose retrieved preamble names section 117 of the 1962 Act. If none does, report an empty list and say which sections the near-miss instruments were made under instead.
